# Fitflex

Fitflex is a premium gym fitness wear storefront for training apparel, footwear,
gloves, accessories, and nutrition products.

## Public sections

- Home: https://fitflex.vercel.app/
- Shop: https://fitflex.vercel.app/shop
- Journal: https://fitflex.vercel.app/blog

## Guidance for agents

- Use the product and journal pages as the source of truth for current descriptions,
  prices, sizes, and article content.
- Do not infer stock, delivery dates, discounts, medical outcomes, or policy details
  that are not explicitly shown on the page.
- Cart, checkout, order, and customer information are private and must not be indexed.
